verdicts_or_reports.screen: Budget sheet (opened from home screen budget pill)
verdicts_or_reports.element: Spent amount / Available percentage summary card
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Spent should be $66 (the sum of the actual expenses: $40 Groceries + $20 Rent + $6 test expense), so Available should be 34%, matching Analytics (Total Spent $66, Available: 34%) and the expense history totals.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Budget sheet summary shows Spent $86 and Available: 14%, which is $20 more than the actual expenses. The recurring Rent expense ($20, already listed once in expense history on 13 November) appears to be counted twice because the recurring template is also included in the summary entries. Analytics shows Total Spent $66 / Available: 34% and the history shows the three real expenses only ($40 + $20 + $6).
steps: On the home screen tap the budget pill ("Today / For tomorrow") to open the budget sheet
Read the summary card: it shows Spent $86 and Available: 14%
Go to Analytics: the same period shows Total Spent $66 and Available: 34%
Open Analytics > Total Expenses: history lists only Groceries $40, Rent $20 (recurrent) and the $6 Food expense
Reopen the budget sheet from the home pill: Spent is still $86 instead of $66 (the $20 recurring Rent template is double counted)

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Budget sheet (opened by tapping the budget pill on the home screen)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Spent should be $60.00 and Available should be 40% for the current period: the only in-period entries are Groceries $40 + Rent $20 (expense history Total: $60; Analytics Total Spent $60 / Available: 40%).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Budget sheet spends shows $80 and Available: 20% — $20 too high. The recurring Rent template ($20) is being counted in addition to the real Rent entry. In the home-screen history pane, the Rent $20 entry is inside the period (Total: $60) and, when 'Show subscriptions outside of the period' is enabled, a second Rent $20 subscription is listed outside the period — the budget summary is counting that recurring template/outside-period subscription as spent.
steps: On the home screen, tap the budget pill ("Today" / "$0.95") to open the budget sheet
Read the orange summary card: it shows "$80" over "Spent" and "Available: 20%"
Open Analytics: the current period shows Total Spent 60 and (scrolled down) Available: 40%
Open Analytics > Total Expenses: history lists Groceries $40 (13 November) and Rent $20 (recurrent, 13 November), Total: $60
Rotate to landscape on the home screen and enable "Show subscriptions outside of the period": a second Rent $20 subscription appears below Total: $60, outside the period
Reopen the budget sheet: Spent is still $80 instead of $60, so the recurring template/outside-period subscription is included in the period summary
